title: Advanced Electrical Safety and Arc Flash

program.section_heading: Advanced Electrical Safety and Arc Flash Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to identify electrical hazards and their effects on the human body.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to describe examples and circumstances of work hazards associated with electrical safety.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to distinguish safe installation and maintenance practices and describe electrically safe working conditions.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to perform a flash hazard analysis and determine the appropriate risk category.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to describe the required work practices for working on or near exposed live parts.

notes: The catalog states 'Credits listed are in hours. (27 Hours total)'; all values are recorded in hours. The closed list's 0 units are not the hours.
The catalog prints the codes without a space (OSRMB70NC, OSRMB63NC, OSRMB58NC); they match closed-list codes OSRM B70NC, OSRM B63NC and OSRM B58NC.
A stray '0' appears under the 'Unit(s)' header before the course rows; it was read as a units column artifact, not a course value.
Each outcome begins with the lead-in 'Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to'. That phrase is inside every numbered item, so the outcomes are copied whole as printed.

Careers come from the line 'appropriate for supervisors, safety personnel, and employees'. This names the intended audience. 'employees' was left out as a generic term. A reviewer may want to confirm whether these count as careers.
